continuation_context.recommended_approach: Implement splitting_zone_match_witness that guarantees sub-interval type matching at depth k-1. The depth-(k+1) NF of u encodes directional info: types above vs below, plus depth-(k-1) 3-var NF data encoding whether types appear between specific pairs. Use this to prove interval_nf_types at depth k-1 for (x,u)/(x',u') and (u,t)/(u',t') agree. Then build bridge hypotheses at depth k-1 for all consecutive pairs in the sorted 3-point configuration. Apply the bridge lemma (IH) at depth k-1 to get 2-var NF agreement for all pairs. This gives the existential transfer at all depths < k-1. Since j' < k-1 (because j'+1 < k), this suffices.
